items.diagnosis: Campaign New/Testing (10 hari, hampir habis tempoh testing 14 hari) - 14D spend naik lagi ke RM1,043.95 (dari RM811.99 run sebelum). SEMUA adset VID & POSTER utk Bangi/Melawati/Putrajaya kini RED.

items.action: Keputusan segera diperlukan sebelum campaign masuk hari ke-14: pause adset Bangi/Melawati (paling lemah), kekalkan Putrajaya kalau CPL masih bawah RM30. Jangan biar scale tanpa review.
items.expected_impact: Jimat RM150-250/hari kalau 2-3 adset lemah di-pause, campaign boleh stabil ke Yellow dlm 3-5 hari.

items.diagnosis: BARU FLIP YELLOW->RED. Campaign Established (22 hari) - CPL 7D naik drpd RM26.59 ke RM30.67, lepas threshold RM30. Ni masalah CPL sebenar (bukan sebab spend-based), perlu disiasat.
items.evidence: CPL 7D RM30.67 (vs RM26.59 run sebelum), CPL 14D RM26.27 (masih ok) - signal CPL memburuk dlm minggu terkini.
items.action: Semak breakdown adset dlm campaign ni - ada beberapa adset BSP NEW/KAJANG yg spend tinggi, kemungkinan tarik CPL naik. Identify & cut adset lemah.
items.expected_impact: Kalau adset lemah di-cut, CPL 7D boleh turun balik ke RM26-27 range dlm 3-4 hari.

items.diagnosis: BARU FLIP ke RED tapi sebab spend-based rule (campaign baru 2 hari, 14D spend RM219.11 lepas threshold RM56). CPL sendiri SIHAT (RM10.96 blended, conversion type Website leads).
items.evidence: Spend 14D RM219.11, CPL blended RM10.96 - jauh bawah target RM15. RED ni false-alarm dari segi lead quality, cuma pace spend yg cepat.
items.action: Jangan panik dgn RED ni. Biar jalan, pantau CPL trend harian. Kalau CPL kekal <RM15 walaupun spend scale cepat, ok teruskan.
items.expected_impact: Data lebih stabil utk keputusan scale/pause minggu depan.

items.diagnosis: Dua campaign dgn CPL 7D terbaik dalam akaun (RM9.71 dan RM7.44) - konsisten GREEN, ruang utk scale.
items.evidence: Retargeting New CPL 7D RM9.71 (14D RM10.97). Online Testing CPL 7D RM7.44 (14D RM7.78).
items.action: Consider naikkan budget 15-20% utk dua campaign/adset ni - ruang scale sebab CPL jauh bawah target RM15.
items.expected_impact: Lebih lead dgn CPL blended akaun yg tetap sihat (CPL blended semalam dah improve ke RM22.43).

delta.context: CPL MTD RM23.08 vs last month full RM23.80 (beza -RM0.72, -3.03%) - improve sikit walaupun byk campaign/adset baru dilancarkan (PCS26, Kelas Petang, BSP NEW, Shah Alam VID6-8). Tapi projected full-month spend ~RM36,473.98 (vs RM30,156.56 bulan lepas) naik 20.9% - run-rate spend tetap naik drastik, projected CPL penuh bulan (RM24.62) lagi tinggi drpd MTD sebab byk adset baru/testing yg CPL belum stabil akan contribute lagi dlm 17 hari lagi bulan ni.
delta.recommendation: CPL okay buat masa ni tapi watch spend run-rate - kalau budget bulanan terhad, kena plan sekarang sama ada nak slow down testing adset baru atau top-up budget. Pantau proportion spend New vs Old, jangan biar testing budget melebihi 25-30% total spend.
